import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out_shape = (C, H // p, W // p)
    out = nl.ndarray(out_shape, dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    tile = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    tile2 = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    for c in nl.affine_range(C):
        for h in nl.affine_range(H // p):
            for w in nl.affine_range(W // p):
                nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x[c, h*p:(h+1)*p, w*p:(w+1)*p])
                nisa.nc_matmul(dst=tile2, stationary=tile, moving=tile, transpose_moving=True)
                nisa.tensor_copy(dst=tile, src=tile2)
                nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=tile, data=0.5, op0=nisa.multiply)
                nisa.dma_copy(dst=out[c, h, w], src=tile)
    return out

@nki.jit
def tensor_transpose2D_kernel_(x, shape2D):
    P, F = x.shape
    F1, F2 = shape2D
    assert F1 * F2 == F, f"shape2D {shape2D} does not match the free size {F}"
    
    # Allocate output buffer in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((P, F), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    # Allocate tile in SBUF
    tile = nl.ndarray((128, F2), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)

    # Transpose within the tile
    for i in nl.affine_range(F1):
        for j in nl.affine_range(F2):
            tile[i, j] = tile[j, i]
    
    # Copy result from SBUF to output
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=tile)

import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def tensor_transpose2D_kernel_(x, shape2D):
    P, F = x.shape
    F1, F2 = shape2D
    assert F1 * F2 == F, f"shape2D {shape2D} does not match the free size {F}"

    out = nl.ndarray((P, F), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    
    # Allocate a tile for the input and output
    tile_in = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    tile_out = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    
    # Compute the number of tiles needed
    num_tiles = (P + 127) // 128
    
    # Loop over each tile
    for p in nl.affine_range(num_tiles):
        # Compute the start and end indices for the current tile
        start_p = p * 128
        end_p = min((p + 1) * 128, P)
        
        # Copy the input data into the tile
        nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile_in, src=x[start_p:end_p, :128])
        
        # Reshape and transpose the tile
        tile_in_reshaped = tile_in.reshape(128, F1, F2)
        tile_out_reshaped = tile_in_reshaped.transpose(0, 2, 1)
        
        # Copy the transposed tile back to the output
        nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile_out, src=tile_in_reshaped)
        
        # Write the transposed data to the output buffer
        nisa.dma_copy(dst=out[start_p:end_p, :], src=tile_out)
    
    return out

    M = lhsT.shape[1]
    N = rhs.shape[1]

    tile_size_K = 128
    num_tiles_K = (K + tile_size_K - 1) // tile_size_K

    tile_out = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)

    num_tiles_p = (P + 127) // 128
    num_tiles_f = (F + 127) // 128
    
    # Loop over the partition dimension

            nisa.dma_copy(dst=out[start_p:end_p, start_f:end_f], src=tile_in_transposed)
